key_highlights: David Jones collapses into voluntary administration, triggering severe headwinds for retail suppliers and mall REITs.
Persistent inflation and RBA excess demand warnings drive forecasts of a residential property price correction.
Qantas faces a $1B fuel cost spike, forcing airfare increases and flight capacity reductions.
ASX 200 closes the week net higher despite daily dips, buoyed by gold equity raisings and digital infrastructure strength.

sectors.trend: Severe distress as flagship department store David Jones enters administration amid subdued consumer spending.
sectors.implications: Elevated re-leasing and vacancy risks for landlords (SCG.AX, VCX.AX); unhedged suppliers face payment defaults.

sectors.trend: Hawkish RBA posture targeting higher unemployment coincides with reduced borrowing capacity and housing crash warnings.
sectors.implications: Asset quality risks and potential credit impairment escalation for major mortgage lenders (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX).

sectors.trend: Robust broker-led capital raising activity across gold producers alongside targeted critical minerals exploration.
sectors.implications: Supportive liquidity for gold and base metal explorers (NST.AX, EVN.AX, CHN.AX, BPM.AX); operational safety remains in focus.

sectors.trend: Aviation margins pressured by a $1B fuel cost increase; energy transition costs mount amid policy reviews.
sectors.implications: Earnings headwinds for QAN.AX leading to fare hikes; distributed energy (battery subsidies) offers selective tech upside.

sectors.trend: Ongoing demand resilience in cloud and AI infrastructure counterbalances broader macroeconomic drag.
sectors.implications: Data centre operators like NEXTDC (NXT.AX) maintain secular growth profile despite domestic consumer weakness.

key_themes: Discretionary retail structural crisis following David Jones administration
Macroeconomic stagflation concerns with persistent inflation and sluggish GDP growth
Mortgage borrowing capacity contraction pressuring housing valuations
Resource sector resilience supported by active gold equity financing

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail property trusts; prioritise prime non-discretionary retail and logistics REITs.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Downturn & Bank Credit Stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to high-LVR mortgage books; favour well-capitalised major banks with diversified revenue.
Reduce cyclical transport allocations; focus on operators with strong pricing power and fuel hedges.
Rotate into defensive, cash-generative sectors including consumer staples and healthcare.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold Producers & Critical Mineral Explorers
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance-sheet financing and safe-haven gold demand provide robust counter-cyclical earnings.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Digital Infrastructure and Cloud Assets
opportunities.rationale: Structural AI data infrastructure demand remains detached from domestic retail weakness.
Essential goods demand insulates revenues from household budget tightening and discretionary decline.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Discretionary Retail and Retail Mall REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones collapse elevates mall vacancy rates, uncollected supplier debt, and rent renegotiation risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Exposure to Airlines and Fuel-Sensitive Transports
defensive_moves.rationale: A $1B fuel cost headwind will squeeze margins as passenger fare elasticity limits pass-through.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Deploy Downside Protection on Benchmark ASX 200
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage capacity contraction and RBA hawkishness pose downside earnings risks for benchmark cyclicals.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX 200 (^AXJO) faces range-bound volatility as consumer discretionary weakness and mortgage headwinds counter mining resilience.
market_outlook.long_term: A 6-12 month earnings divergence favours gold miners and digital infrastructure over cyclical retail and debt-sensitive real estate.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and cash rate trajectory
David Jones creditor negotiations and liquidation/store closure updates
Global oil and jet fuel price trends impacting transport margins
Australian quarterly CPI and household savings rate data
Residential mortgage stress indicators and auction clearance trends
watch_list: RBA cash rate expectations and commentary
Shopping centre foot traffic and tenant default rates
Gold and iron ore spot commodity prices
Major bank net interest margins and loan loss provisions
